claims.statement: In the changelog preview, changes can be combined into one changeset or moved to ignored by drag and drop.
claims.supports: Drag and drop combines changes into one changeset or moves them to be ignored

claims.statement: Primary and secondary changelogs separate safe changes from those needing manual attention, by change type or manually.

claims.statement: Remove from Changelog offers Remove, Remove and Ignore (excluded from future changesets) and Restore from Ignored.
claims.supports: Remove, Remove and Ignore, Restore from Ignored

claims.statement: Flyway preview supports Add Migration, Remove from Migration (optionally to Ignored), Restore from Ignored, Move to Another Migration.
claims.supports: Add Migration; Remove from Migration; Restore from Ignored; Move to Another Migration

claims.statement: Change types can be assigned to primary/secondary location or ignored; ignored changes are listed in an Ignored section.
